content.user_title: Audit and Improve App Store Metadata
content.value_statement: App store listings can meet character limits while still using unclear copy or weak keywords. This skill combines ASOScan scores, recommendations, and change history with specific rewrites and localized drafts.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve account apps, ASO scores, recommendations, listing metadata, and change history through connected ASOScan tools or authenticated API calls.
Interpret overall and pillar scores with explicit denominators and distinguish completeness checks from copy quality.
Draft field-specific improvements with exact text and character counts for Apple and Google listing limits.
Review Apple keyword fields for repetition, filler, generic terms, and competitor trademarks.
Show saved localization drafts and request new locale-specific drafts after approval of AI costs and saved changes.
Report missing metadata, access failures, credit limits, and localization preparation messages without inventing results.
limitations: Requires connected ASOScan tools or shell access with an existing ASOSCAN_API_KEY for live account data.
Only accesses account apps and tracked competitors; keyword selection relies on related skills.
Cannot publish listing text to stores or guarantee ranking improvements; conversion scores may use proxies.
New localization drafts cost 2 API credits and 1 AI credit and require approval. Verify decision-critical platform limits against official documentation.

use_cases.title: Improve an independent app listing
use_cases.description: Review an Apple listing, identify weak fields, and draft concise title, subtitle, and keyword changes with character counts.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Google Play copy changes
use_cases.description: Combine ASOScan recommendations, score limitations, and metadata history to prioritize accurate short and full description improvements.

use_cases.title: Prepare localized listing drafts
use_cases.description: Review saved locale drafts and request new variants after confirming costs, then compare character counts before manual store submission.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Audit one listing
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [app name] on [platform] in [country]. Show ASOScan scores with denominators and suggest three specific metadata improvements.
prompt_templates.scenario: A first review of an existing app listing.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Rewrite key fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [app name] on [platform]. Rewrite its title and subtitle or short description using [target keywords]. Include exact character counts and reasons.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused copy improvements using previously selected keywords.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Review listing changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review metadata history and current ASOScan recommendations for [app name] in [country]. Prioritize field changes without claiming that history proves ranking effects.
prompt_templates.scenario: An evidence-based review of recent listing edits.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Prepare a localized draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Check saved [locale] drafts for [app name] first. Before generating or saving a new draft, explain the costs and wait for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: A controlled localization workflow with explicit spending and change approval.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Rewrite a task planner listing with clear benefits and Apple character limits.
output: Suggested title: Focus List: Daily Planner. Character count: 25/30.
Suggested subtitle: Plan tasks and stay focused. Character count: 27/30.
Reason: The title identifies the product category, and the subtitle describes its practical benefit.
Confirm that these statements match the app before submitting the text.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Explain why a metadata score of 25/25 does not mean the listing copy is optimal.
output: Metadata score: 25/25. This indicates completeness and character-limit compliance, not persuasive or relevant copy.
Next review: Check whether the title uses a relevant search term and the subtitle states a clear benefit.
Conversion scores may be estimates and cannot judge screenshot content.

best_practices: Confirm the app, platform, country, and current metadata before drafting changes.
Use ASOScan scores with denominators and explain where completeness checks or conversion proxies limit interpretation.
Keep credentials private and obtain approval before paid AI calls or data changes. Verify decision-critical platform limits against official documentation.
anti_patterns: Treating a perfect completeness score as proof that listing copy or screenshots are optimal.
Repeating Apple keywords, stuffing Google descriptions, or adding unsupported awards and ranking guarantees.
Generating paid localization drafts without approval or presenting saved drafts as published store updates.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: Connect ASOScan tools, or use shell access with an existing ASOSCAN_API_KEY. Without either option, the workflow refers you to asoscan-setup.

faq.question: Does the skill publish changes to app stores?
faq.answer: No. Localization drafts are saved in ASOScan, and users manually transfer approved text to App Store Connect or Google Play Console.

faq.question: Which operations cost credits?
faq.answer: The listed reads are free. A new localized draft costs 2 API credits and 1 AI credit and requires approval.

faq.question: Does a metadata score of 25/25 mean my copy is optimal?
faq.answer: No. It measures completeness and character-limit compliance. The workflow separately reviews relevance, benefits, and wording.

faq.question: Can this skill choose my target keywords?
faq.answer: It applies chosen keywords and checks field usage. Keyword discovery and selection are delegated to keyword-opportunities or keyword-intelligence.

faq.question: Will localization guarantee better keyword rankings?
faq.answer: No. The skill prepares localized text and explains supported search visibility benefits without guaranteeing ranking improvements.
